messages:
maria-ops: Heads-up — we just executed a priority shift after EU2 node churn pushed GPU usable capacity below 20%. Shifted ~40% of EU2 GPU traffic to SFO (reserved) and AMS (burst). Keeping this thread for cost reconciliation + runbook edits.

leo-sre: Copy. Can you paste the exact routing change?

maria-ops: ```
# manual weight update
redwoodctl traffic set-weight --from eu2 --to sfo=0.25,ams=0.15 --reason \"evict-surge-eu2\"
```

aj-mlinfra: Did autoscaler fail to react? What caused capacity drop?

maria-ops: Evictions spiked after a noisy tenant overloaded gpux nodes -> kubelet OOM churn. Autoscaler did attempt to provision but preemptible/spot reservations were exhausted in region. Warm-pool had 1.2x but not enough.

leo-sre: Marking for post-incident: adjust warm-pool ordering and add preemptible fallback throttle in runbook. Also need clearer guidance on manual weight thresholds.

tara-prod: Customer impact: small uptick in tail latency for EU customers for 7m, but fallbacks prevented errors. We should record SLA blip and tell support to watch for regressions.

maria-ops: Costs: initial estimate shows ~$1.1k extra in burst GPU hours for the 45m window, plus ~0.3k in cross-region egress. Finbot will confirm.

finbot: Preliminary charge estimate: [burst compute] $1,120; [egress] $310; total approx $1,430. Allocation tag: infra-incident-1798887777.

leo-sre: Action items (assignments inline):
- update runbook \"conditional priority shift\" section: define percent thresholds, cooldowns, owner (maria-ops)
- add step to check warm-pool ordering and increase warm-pool target when eviction rate > 5% for 3m (aj-mlinfra)
- add a preemptible-exhaustion branch to the autoscaler checklist (leo-sre)
- add cost guardrail: if estimated burst cost > $2k, require on-call manager approval (tara-prod)

maria-ops: I'll draft runbook edits and push a PR to infra/runbooks. Will include the exact CLI snippet and a small troubleshooting checklist.

aj-mlinfra: Also adding: ensure metric 'gpu.node.evictions' is added to paging rule for ~5m sustained at p95 to pre-trigger oncall.

leo-sre: Good. One more: add a one-click rollback snippet that restores weights and notifies accept-traffic flag. Example: ```
redwoodctl traffic restore --from eu2 --window 10m --confirm
```

maria-ops: Noted. I'll include the rollback and an appendix with the cost accounting tags.

ops-bot: Incident 1798887777: priority-shift executed, status = mitigated, duration = 00:45:12. Postmortem checklist created -> /ops/incidents/1798887777.

tara-prod: Please add a short blurb for support and a link to the postmortem when done.

maria-ops: Will do. Draft PR link: https://git.redwood/infrarunbooks/pulls/1123 (WIP). Expect to request reviews from @leo-sre and @aj-mlinfra by EOD.

leo-sre: Thanks. After PR merge, let's schedule a quick dry-run of the shift procedure in staging next week. :thumbsup:

maria-ops: Agree. Scheduling now.

finbot: Final note: allocate incident costs to Q1 infra incident budget; tagging complete.

maria-ops: Closing thread once PR merged and postmortem published. If anyone has additional items, reply here.
